lines: INTERVIEWER: WHY DO YOU WANT TO WORK HERE?
ME: I'VE DEVELOPED A STRONG INTEREST IN PAYING RENT.
MONDAY: I HATE MY JOB.
WEDNESDAY: I HATE MY JOB.
FRIDAY: I LOVE MY JOB.
SUNDAY NIGHT: I HATE MY JOB.
"WE'RE LIKE A FAMILY HERE."
GREAT. SO I'LL SEE YOU TWICE A YEAR AND AVOID YOU THE REST OF THE TIME.
MY WORK BESTIE ISN'T JUST A FRIEND.
SHE'S A WITNESS.
THIS MEETING COULD HAVE BEEN AN EMAIL.
THAT EMAIL COULD HAVE BEEN NOTHING.
ME: I'M LEAVING ON TIME TODAY.
MY BOSS AT 4:55 PM: "BEFORE YOU GO..."
WORK UNTIL I'M 65?
I'M NOT EVEN SURE I'LL MAKE IT TO LUNCH.
I DON'T NEED ANOTHER WELLNESS WEBINAR.
I NEED TO GET PAID ENOUGH TO AFFORD THERAPY.
UNLIMITED PTO IS LIKE UNLIMITED BREADSTICKS.
SURE, YOU CAN. BUT EVERYONE STARES IF YOU TAKE TOO MANY.
SOME PEOPLE FIND PEACE IN YOGA.
I FIND IT WHEN MY BOSS IS ON PTO.
MY BOSS: "WE NEED YOU TO BE A TEAM PLAYER."
TRANSLATION: DO YOUR JOB AND KEVIN'S.
SKILLS I'VE MASTERED AT WORK:
LOOKING BUSY.
SAYING "SOUNDS GOOD."
LEAVING AT EXACTLY 5:00.
CALLING IN SICK TAKES MORE ACTING SKILL THAN ANYTHING I'VE EVER DONE AT THIS JOB.
MY BOSS SAYS HIS DOOR IS ALWAYS OPEN.
THAT'S HOW HE HEARS EVERYTHING.
TEAM BUILDING:
WHEN YOUR COMPANY MAKES YOU PLAY GAMES WITH THE EXACT PEOPLE YOU AVOID ALL WEEK.
MY JOB IS 90% SAYING "HAPPY TO HELP" TO THINGS THAT MAKE ME DEEPLY UNHAPPY.
